xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Selected source assignment occurs only in playable operands.
Warmup segment requests run concurrently; full-copy resource scheduler caps concurrency at 4 and Reel downloads at 1.
Worker owns HTTP/download/index/eviction operations; local storage is deliberately aggregated with it.
No device playback behavior has been verified.
